{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast bias when sentiment is negative (sentiment < 0) — model tends to overestimate prices.",
    "Adjust downward for forecasts that overshoot recent highs — especially after spikes in price.",
    "Apply mean reversion correction if forecast deviates > ±10% from 5-day moving average of true outcomes.",
    "Lower forecast for 30-day horizon when sentiment is negative and price is trending downward.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent low prices when sentiment is positive — model underreacts to bullish signals.",
    "Correct for lagged response: if true outcome drops sharply, forecast should adjust earlier than 3-day horizon.",
    "When sentiment is positive and price is falling, reduce forecast by 5–10% to avoid overcorrection."
  ]
}
